title: Specialized LLM Chains
summary: This module provides advanced LLM chains for specific tasks like applying constitutional principles, active retrieval-augmented generation (FLARE), and self-verifying summarization. These chains enhance LLM outputs through iterative critique, contextual retrieval, or assertion-based revision.

nodes.label: Apply Constitutional Principles
nodes.title: ConstitutionalChain
nodes.description: Applies a set of constitutional principles to an LLM's output, iteratively critiquing and revising the response to align with desired guidelines.

nodes.label: Perform Active RAG (FLARE)
nodes.title: FlareChain
nodes.description: Implements the FLARE (Active Retrieval Augmented Generation) approach, identifying uncertain parts of a generated response, formulating questions, retrieving relevant documents, and then revising the response with new context.

nodes.label: Self-Verify & Revise Summary
nodes.title: LLMSummarizationCheckerChain
nodes.description: A chain that generates assertions from an LLM-produced summary, checks these assertions for accuracy, and then revises the summary based on the verification results.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: A large language model used for generating text, critiques, revisions, questions, and assertions within the specialized chains.

nodes.label: Document Retriever
nodes.title: BaseRetriever
nodes.description: A component responsible for fetching relevant documents or information based on a given query, used by the FLARE chain.

nodes.label: Initial LLM Response
nodes.title: Initial LLM Response
nodes.description: The initial text generated by a language model before any constitutional principles are applied.

nodes.label: User Query
nodes.title: User Query
nodes.description: The original input query provided by the user to the FLARE chain.

nodes.label: Input Summary
nodes.title: Input Summary
nodes.description: A summary generated by an LLM that needs to be self-verified and potentially revised.

nodes.label: Constitutional Principles
nodes.title: Constitutional Principles
nodes.description: A set of rules or guidelines used by the ConstitutionalChain to critique and revise LLM outputs.

nodes.label: Generate Critique
nodes.title: Critique Generation
nodes.description: An internal step within ConstitutionalChain that generates a critique of the current response based on a constitutional principle.

nodes.label: Generate Revision
nodes.title: Revision Generation
nodes.description: An internal step within ConstitutionalChain that revises the response based on a critique and a revision request.

nodes.label: Generate Questions from Uncertainty
nodes.title: Question Generation
nodes.description: An internal step within FlareChain that identifies low-confidence spans in a partial response and generates questions to retrieve more information.

nodes.label: Generate Response with Context
nodes.title: Response Generation
nodes.description: An internal step within FlareChain that generates or refines a response using the user input and retrieved contextual documents.

nodes.label: Create Assertions
nodes.title: Assertion Creation
nodes.description: An internal step within LLMSummarizationCheckerChain that generates factual assertions from the input summary.

nodes.label: Check Assertions
nodes.title: Assertion Verification
nodes.description: An internal step within LLMSummarizationCheckerChain that verifies the truthfulness of the generated assertions.

nodes.label: Revise Summary
nodes.title: Summary Revision
nodes.description: An internal step within LLMSummarizationCheckerChain that revises the summary based on the results of the assertion checks.

nodes.label: Retrieved Documents
nodes.title: Retrieved Documents
nodes.description: Documents fetched by the retriever, providing context for the FLARE chain's response generation.

nodes.label: Final Revised Output
nodes.title: Final Revised Output
nodes.description: The final LLM response after being critiqued and revised according to constitutional principles.

nodes.label: Final FLARE Response
nodes.title: Final FLARE Response
nodes.description: The complete and refined response generated by the FLARE chain after iterative retrieval and generation.

nodes.label: Final Checked Summary
nodes.title: Final Checked Summary
nodes.description: The summary after being self-verified and potentially revised for accuracy.

groups.label: Constitutional AI Process
groups.title: Constitutional AI Process
groups.description: Orchestrates the application of constitutional principles to refine LLM outputs through iterative critique and revision.

groups.label: FLARE (Active RAG) Process
groups.title: FLARE (Active RAG) Process
groups.description: Manages the FLARE workflow, dynamically generating questions from uncertain response parts, retrieving context, and refining the output.

groups.label: Summary Self-Correction
groups.title: Summary Self-Correction
groups.description: Handles the self-verification of LLM-generated summaries by creating, checking, and revising assertions to ensure accuracy.
